correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed cubic Franklin graph and enumerated all 4096 vertex subsets; precisely 723 augmented faces with cardinalities 1,12,66,184,264,168,28. Exhaustive toggle matching gives 357 augmented pairs and 9 critical faces, equivalently 356 nonempty pairs with one critical vertex, two 3-cells and seven 4-cells; 2748 Hasse incidences have no directed cycle. Fresh signed integral Morse reduction independently reproduces the 2-by-7 differential with columns (1,0),(1,0),(1,-1),(0,-1),(0,0),(0,-1),(-1,1), containing unit minor -1. The 3-skeleton is two S3 spheres, and unimodular attachment cancellation gives wedge5 S4, not merely mod2 homology. Independent automorphism enumeration finds order48 and signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz traces by cycle type [id:5, 1^8 2^2:-3 x3, 1^4 2^4:1 x3, 2^6:-1 x12 and +1 x1, 2^2 4^2:1 x12, 3^4:-1 x8, 6^2:1 x8]. Weighted trace sum is zero, so rational H4 has no invariants; rational homology of finite simplicial quotient equals invariants after subdivision, proving rationally acyclic quotient (not contractible).
